# Example usage:
#  mkdir build
#  cd build
#  cmake -g "Visual Studio 14 2015" ..

rblxbuild_minimum_required(VERSION 2.8)
project(rblxui_example_rblxwin_vulkan C CXX)

if(NOT RBLXBUILD_BUILD_TYPE)
  set(RBLXBUILD_BUILD_TYPE Debug CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
endif()

set(RBLXBUILD_CXX_STANDARD 11)
set (RBLXBUILD_C_FLAGS "${RBLXBUILD_C_FLAGS} -DVK_PROTOTYPES")
set (RBLXBUILD_CXX_FLAGS "${RBLXBUILD_CXX_FLAGS} -DVK_PROTOTYPES")

# RBLXWIN
if(NOT RBLXWIN_DIR)
   set(RBLXWIN_DIR ../../../rblxwin) # Set this to point to an up-to-date RBLXWIN repo
endif()
option(RBLXWIN_BUILD_EXAMPLES "Build the RBLXWIN example programs" OFF)
option(RBLXWIN_BUILD_TESTS "Build the RBLXWIN test programs" OFF)
option(RBLXWIN_BUILD_DOCS "Build the RBLXWIN documentation" OFF)
option(RBLXWIN_INSTALL "Generate installation target" OFF)
option(RBLXWIN_DOCUMENT_INTERNALS "Include internals in documentation" OFF)
add_subdirectory(${RBLXWIN_DIR} binary_dir EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
include_directories(${RBLXWIN_DIR}/include)

# Dear RblxUI
set(RBLXUI_DIR ../../)
include_directories(${RBLXUI_DIR} ${RBLXUI_DIR}/backends ..)

# Libraries
find_package(Vulkan REQUIRED)
#find_library(VULKAN_LIBRARY
  #NAMES vulkan vulkan-1)
#set(LIBRARIES "rblxwin;${VULKAN_LIBRARY}")
set(LIBRARIES "rblxwin;Vulkan::Vulkan")

# Use vulkan headers from rblxwin:
include_directories(${RBLXWIN_DIR}/deps)

file(GLOB sources *.cpp)

add_executable(example_rblxwin_vulkan ${sources} ${RBLXUI_DIR}/backends/rblxui_impl_rblxwin.cpp ${RBLXUI_DIR}/backends/rblxui_impl_vulkan.cpp ${RBLXUI_DIR}/rblxui.cpp ${RBLXUI_DIR}/rblxui_draw.cpp ${RBLXUI_DIR}/rblxui_demo.cpp ${RBLXUI_DIR}/rblxui_tables.cpp ${RBLXUI_DIR}/rblxui_widgets.cpp)
target_link_libraries(example_rblxwin_vulkan ${LIBRARIES})
